text: @local/chat-message-export 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的对话导出插件，在已完成的助手回复操作条和会话标题栏分别加入导出按钮。点击单条回复按钮可将该回复保存为 Markdown；点击会话标题栏按钮可按当前可见顺序导出整个对话，包含用户消息和每轮最终回复。工具调用和思考过程不会写入整段对话导出。导出通过浏览器下载生成文件，不需要额外 API Key 或外部服务。

Adds two export buttons to DSH Web chat: one for a completed reply and one in the session header. Download a reply or the visible conversation as Markdown. The transcript includes user messages and final replies, omitting tool calls and reasoning. Browser downloads need no key or external service.
想把一条助手回复保存成 Markdown 文件。
有没有办法把当前聊天记录下载下来留档？
I want to save my visible chat transcript as a Markdown file.
@local/chat-message-export 的功能「导出单条回复」：在已完成的助手消息操作条点击导出按钮，将回复正文保存为带时间戳的 Markdown 文件。
@local/chat-message-export 的功能「导出当前对话」：点击会话标题栏按钮，按可见顺序生成 Markdown 对话稿，包含用户消息和每轮最终回复。

@local/chat-message-export README · chat-message-export：English | [中文](README.zh.md)

A DeepSeek Harness plugin that exports chat content as Markdown files.

| Where | Action | Output |
|---|---|---|
| Each finalized assistant reply's action strip | Download this reply | `deepseek-reply-<timestamp>.md` |
| Session header | Download the whole visible conversation | `deepseek-conversation-<timestamp>.md` |

@local/chat-message-export README · chat-message-export：The conversation export reads the Chat store's visible node order: user and
steering messages become `## User` sections, and each Turn contributes only its
final reply — tool calls and reasoning are skipped, so the file reads as a
transcript rather than a log.

@local/chat-message-export README · Why user bubbles have no button of their own：The Harness exposes per-message actions only through
`conversation.chat.assistant-actions`, which fires for finalized assistant
messages. User-row controls (copy, timestamp) are built into the host component
with no extension slot, so adding one there would mean re-implementing the whole
user row — attachments, images, references, pending and echo states — and
tracking upstream markup. The session-header export covers the user side instead.
section: Why user bubbles have no button of their own

text:
@local/chat-message-export README · Install：From a DeepSeek Harness session, point `plugin_manager` at this directory:

```
plugin_manager { action: "install_bundle", target: "<abs path>/chat-message-export" }
```

The package is linked into the active profile, so it applies to every session in
that profile and survives restart. Refresh the Web page afterwards; the browser
assembles client modules at page load.

@local/chat-message-export README · Install：For a local development loop, the Web client watches its own plugin bundles — a
rebuilt `client.js` can reload without a page refresh.

@local/chat-message-export README · Layout：```
client.js          browser half: slot entries, Markdown rendering, downloads
index.js           host half (empty; everything renders in the browser)
cordis.patch.yml   Loader row that inserts the package
package.json       dsh.bundle.patch + dsh.client metadata

Plain JavaScript — no build step, no dependencies. The browser half registers
through `window.__ModuleLoader__.load` and contributes two slot entries:

@local/chat-message-export README · Layout：- `conversation.chat.assistant-actions`, id `export`, order `20`
- `conversation.session.header.actions`, id `export-conversation`, order `30`

UI text goes through the Client locale service (`ctx.locale.register`); styles
use only `--dsw-alias-*` theme tokens, so the buttons follow light and dark
themes. Downloads use a transient `<a download>` with an object URL, so no Host
route or file write is involved, and the styles tag is removed when the plugin
unloads.
